## Standing operator rules
Never edit config/ledgerly.toml without posting its diff in #billing-config for @maya. Never modify files under ledgerly/customer_export/ without posting the proposed diff in #privacy-review and receiving approval from @mina. Staging exports now go to ledgerly-exports-stg-v2. The old ledgerly-exports-stg bucket is frozen for an audit and must not be written to.

## Current objective
Continue annotating `ledgerly/billing/invoices.py`; the dunning scheduler fix is superseded. The router split is paused/superseded.

## Ruled-out approaches
Do not retry Celery visibility-timeout increases to 6 hours; they hid stuck duplicate jobs for hours. Do not retry all `HTTPStatusError` responses; this retried 4xx failures such as 422. Retry only `httpx.TransportError` and retryable server responses.

## Recent work
Fixed CSV exports to write UTF-8 explicitly and added UTF-8 regression coverage; exporter tests, Ruff, and full suite passed (`186 passed, 3 skipped`). Confirmed webhook-v2 deployment update succeeded. Began invoice typing: baseline passed (`12 passed`), then imported `Decimal`, `Iterable`, and `TypedDict` and annotated `LineItem`; more invoice helper annotations and tests remain.
